title: Difference quotients of a weak solution satisfy the averaged linearized weak equation
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l), Psi : L -> R of class C^2 with A := D Psi and B := D^2 Psi, U and V open subsets of R^n, u, g : R^n -> R^l with u of class C^1 on U and g continuous on U, e in R^n and d a nonzero real number, such that x + (td)e lies in U for all x in V and t in [0,1]. Assume that the integral over U of A(Du(x))[Dphi(x)] dx equals minus the integral over U of <phi(x), g(x)> dx for every C^1 compactly supported phi : R^n -> R^l with tsupport phi contained in U. Then for every C^1 compactly supported zeta : R^n -> R^l with tsupport zeta contained in V: the integral over V of ( integral_0^1 B(Du(x) + t(Du(x + de) - Du(x)))[d^{-1}(Du(x + de) - Du(x))][Dzeta(x)] dt ) dx equals the integral over V of < integral_0^1 g(x + (td)e) dt , Dzeta(x)e > dx.
